# Keep true selection separate from context menu action targets

mailTabs getters return the real selection even while a popup temporarily targets an unselected row. Menu onShown/onClicked data follows the UI action: the entire selection if the clicked item is inside it, otherwise only the clicked item. The accepted design rejected added clickedFolder/clickedMessage fields. Current ExtensionMailTabs also expands a selected collapsed row into its message headers; copying the 2024 one-header map would lose that behavior. Test getters before, during and after the popup, and test clicks inside and outside a multiple selection.

Scope: mail/components/extensions.
